verdict.rationale: Chronicle ingests production data, traces and telemetry, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents no retention settings, deletion APIs or data-purge controls. The twin 'Reset' feature only restores simulated environment state to its seed, which is an adjacent behavior rather than user control over data retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
